Hello everyone, and good evening! I have finally finished this new episode for the DarkFlame Anthology, which I've called "Cherrie Blossom VS Sheen"! You might be wondering, where's the preview? Why did you post the whole story directly? Well, that is because this May was a horrible month for me, which also affected the story in a negative way. I consider this story to be below the average quality that my stories usually have, so I have decided it would only be fair to release it for free to everyone, except the "Special Edition". The download link for the story can be found in my Fanbox link below! I hope you like it regardless.

Here's a short synopsis of the story:
When she was a little child, Laura loved this TV cartoon called "Cherrie Blossom". And by chance or luck of fate, an interdimensional benevolent being granted her powers to become her beloved TV character! Although, people change when they grow up, and for Laura, she grew tired of Cherrie Blossom and loathed transforming into Cherrie Blossom to fight against villains.

If you want the story, you can go to my Fanbox page and you will get a download link for you to keep!
